arabic text: AAJ RUKHSAT HORAHI HAI TUMSEY ZEHRA YA ALI\nAAJ RUKHSAT HORAHI HAI TUMSEY ZEHRA YA ALI
english translation text: ZAHRA IS BIDDING YOU\nFAREWELL TODAY YOU O ALI

arabic text: KYA KAHOO DIL MEY KHAYAAL AATEY HAI KYA KYA YA ALI
english translation text: WHAT SHOULD I SAY ABOUT THE THOUGHTS THAT ARE COMING TO ME O ALI?

arabic text: HA MADEENEY WAALO KO THA MERA RONA NAA GAWAAR
english translation text: THE PEOPLE OF MADINA DISAPPROVED OF MY CRYING

arabic text: AAJ SE HOGA NA IN LOGO KO SHIKWA YA ALI
english translation text: FROM TODAY, THEY WILL NOT COMPLAIN TO YOU O ALI.

arabic text: DUSHMANO KO TUM NA AANEY DENA MERI LAASH PAR
english translation text: DO NOT LET MY ENEMIES COME TO MY FUNERAL

arabic text: PARDA E SHAB MEY MERI MAYYAT UTHAANA YA ALI
english translation text: CARRY MY COFFIN IN THE VEILS OF THE DARKNESS O ALI

arabic text: BAAD MEREY JAANEY KYA HO HAAL BACHO KA MERE
english translation text: WHAT WILL BE THE STATE OF MY CHILDREN AFTER ME?

arabic text: UNKO EEZA HO TO HOGI MUJHKO EEZA YA ALI
english translation text: ANYTHING THAT HURTS THEM WILL HURT ME O ALI.

arabic text: FAAQEY KARKEY AAFATO SE MY NEY PAALA HAI INHEY
english translation text: I HAVE NURTURED THEM WITH GREAT DIFFICULTY

arabic text: TUM KHAYAAL INKA MERI KHAATIR SE RAKHNA YA ALI
english translation text: FOR MY SAKE, PLEASE TAKE CARE OF THEM DEARLY O ALI

arabic text: JAANTEY HAI AAP YE NAAZO KA PAALA HAI HUSAIN
english translation text: YOU KNOW THAT I HAVE BROUGHT UP HUSSAIN (AS) WITH GREAT CARE AND LOVE

arabic text: WO AGAR ROYE DILAASA ISKO DENA YA ALI
english translation text: IF HE CRIES PLEASE CONSOLE HIM O ALI

arabic text: TUMKO ZEHMAT HOGI LEKIN MERI TASKEE'N KE LIYE
english translation text: IT WILL BE HARD FOR YOU BUT FOR MY COMFORT

arabic text: MERI TURBAT PAR MEREY BACHO KO LAANA YA ALI
english translation text: PLEASE BRING MY CHILDREN TO MY GRAVE O ALI
O SAEED (NAME OF POET), IMAM ALI STAYED STRONG ALTHOUGH HEARTBROKEN

arabic text: BOLI ZEHRA JAB KHUDAA HAAFIZ TUMHAARA YA ALI
english translation text: WHEN BIBI ZAHRA SAID KHUDA HAFIZ O ALI
